whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mani Martial Art's Academy,

I noticed your academy has stellar 4.8★ reviews in Khajpura, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke martial arts & fitness academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense classes, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/manimartialarts

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Mani Martial Art's Academy, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and batch schedules for your Khajpura location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact training programs, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
